NONE: › a brand name for a type of small strong vehicle used for travelling over rough ground, especially by the army
（尤指軍隊用的）吉普車，越野車

example: Jeepers, just look at the time! I'm going to be late!
哎呀，看看都幾點了！我要遲到了！

NONE: › to laugh or shout insults at someone to show you have no respect for them

example: The people at the back of the hall jeered (at) the speaker.
坐在禮堂後面的人嘲笑發言者。

NONE: › an expression of surprise or strong emotion
（表示驚訝或強烈的感情）天哪，哎呀

example: Jeez, don't yell at me - I'm just telling you what she said!
天哪，別對我大嚷大叫——我只是告訴你她說了些甚麼！
